text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The crimson bird of mystery soaring down 
the track! El Condor Pasa has arrived!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I want to run so bad my legs are 
itching for it-DEEEESU!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sì!! Today El is blazing, burning, and in 
peak condition!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No matter who my opponent is, I have not 
the slightest intention of losing!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In this race, El Condor Pasa will claim an 
overwhelming VICTORYYYYY!
